annotations.title: My sounds: one-off sounds without a game

description: For a one-off sound that does not belong to a game or project the user is making ("make me a coin sound", "I need a rain loop", a single track). Returns the account's "My sounds" project (the same place as the sound field on the site's home), created on the first call: its id, its page (url) and its root folders (Ambience, Sound effects, Interface, Voices, Music). Then use the usual tools with that id: create_event in the right folder and generate_sounds, generate_music or generate_voice (same cost rules: the user approves the exact total first). Loose sounds DO NOT go to Godot: the plugin only works with games. If the user wants the sound in a Godot project, or is making a game, use create_game instead (a sound already made here can be brought to a game on the site, with "Bring from another game"). A video, podcast or app with several sounds is a project (create_game with kind=project), not loose sounds. My sounds has no entities (only games and projects do) and no choosing (every version of a loose sound IS the sound: it all shows when public and downloads together; delete the versions the user does not want), and each loose sound is public or private on its own (public on the free plan; on a paid plan the user picks it with the padlock on the site; until the user picks once on the site Home, new loose sounds stay private): a public one shows in the Community list, in Sounds and on Home.
